## Report: 3 ÖkoInvest-Ratgeber fertig (nicht committet)

I wrote the three article files and registered them with `node scripts/ratgeber-index.mjs`. I changed no other files and made no commits. All three pages load with HTTP 200. In the full check at 390 px, scrollWidth equals clientWidth (no horizontal overflow). The wide tables scroll inside their frame (`minBreite` is set) and there are no console or runtime errors from my articles. I checked the desktop hero at 1440 px visually for all three.

- At the start, `/ratgeber/...` returned 404 and timed out a few times. The cause was the busy dev server and the index being regenerated in parallel by other agents. After re-indexing, all three return 200.
- There was a one-off hydration warning on the PPA article that did not come back when I repeated the check.

### 1. `projektrechte-kaufen-due-diligence` – "Projektrechte kaufen: Preise, Vertragsstruktur und Due Diligence"
- **File:** `C:\Users\SALEADMIN\Downloads\Oekoinvest-Web\src\content\ratgeber\projektrechte-kaufen-due-diligence.js`
- **Length:** about 2,075 words, 10 min. reading time. 4 tables, 6 FAQs, 18 internal links.
- **Content:** a PHASEN table with €/kWp, the purchase price for 20 MWp, risk and months to RTB. Share Deal vs. Asset Deal table. Documents in order as an `ablauf`: NDA, LOI, DD, SPA, closing. A milestone table with earn-out, based on the average RTB value. DD checklists (legal, technical, commercial, tax). Red flags, a `recht` box, and a PROVISION table with a fee example.
- **Sources:**
  - BGB § 1090: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/__1090.html
  - BGB § 1092: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/__1092.html
  - GmbHG § 15: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/gmbhg/__15.html
  - GrEStG § 1: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/grestg_1983/__1.html
  - EEG § 37: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/eeg_2014/__37.html
  - RIS öGmbHG § 76: https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/eli/rgbl/1906/58/P76/NOR12040505
  - BNetzA Ausschreibungen Solar: https://www.bundesnetzagentur.de/DE/Fachthemen/ElektrizitaetundGas/Ausschreibungen/Solaranlagen1/start.html
- **Worded cautiously:**
  - The milestone split (20/30/40/10 %) is labelled as an example.
  - Exclusivity and DD duration are not stated as fixed numbers.
  - GrESt is only mentioned when the SPV owns land.
  - The AT/CH section is short and recommends local advice.

### 2. `grossspeicher-erloese` – "Batteriegroßspeicher: Erlöse, Marktlage 2026 und Rechenbeispiel"
- **File:** `C:\Users\SALEADMIN\Downloads\Oekoinvest-Web\src\content\ratgeber\grossspeicher-erloese.js`
- **Length:** about 1,900 words, 10 min. reading time on the page. 3 tables, 6 FAQs.
- **Worked example (10 MW / 20 MWh):** calculated in the code with `irr()`. Project IRR is about 6.4 % / 14.7 % / 23.9 % (cautious / mid / good). Without the construction cost subsidy (BKZ), the mid case is about 18.4 %.
- **Legal status:**
  - BGH 15.07.2025, EnVR 1/24: BKZ for storage is permitted.
  - § 118 Abs. 6 EnWG: 20-year exemption for commissioning by 04.08.2029, with the regulator's power to deviate (Satz 12).
  - AgNes interim status May 2026: protection of legitimate expectations if the investment decision was made before the final ruling.
  - § 35 Abs. 1 Nr. 11/12 BauGB: at least 4 MW, 200 m to a substation, 0.5 % / 50,000 m².
  - Short AT (ElWG/E-Control, still disputed) and CH (Art. 14a StromVG) sections.
- **Sources:**
  - pv magazine / RWTH ISEA index: https://www.pv-magazine.de/2026/01/23/erloespotenziale-fuer-stationaere-batteriespeicher-in-deutschland-sind-2025-zurueckgegangen/
  - BGH press release: https://www.bundesgerichtshof.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/DE/2025/2025129.html
  - EnWG § 118: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/enwg_2005/__118.html
  - BauGB § 35: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bbaug/__35.html
  - BNetzA Stromspeicher: https://www.bundesnetzagentur.de/DE/Fachthemen/ElektrizitaetundGas/Speicher/start.html
  - pv magazine, 573.5 GW requested / 54.2 GW approved: https://www.pv-magazine.de/2026/08/25/netzanschluesse-fuer-batteriespeicher-574-gigawatt-angefragt-54-gigawatt-zugesagt/
  - pv magazine on AgNes: https://www.pv-magazine.de/2026/05/27/bundesnetzagentur-netzentgeltbefreiung-fuer-batteriespeicher-bleibt-bis-2029-mehrkosten-fuer-prosumer/
  - dena PPA-Marktanalyse 2025: https://www.dena.de/fileadmin/dena/Publikationen/PDFs/2026/PPA_Marktanalyse_2025.pdf
- **Uncertainties:**
  - Opex of 2 % of capex, revenue decline of 3 % per year and a 15-year lifetime are marked as the article's own assumptions, not market sources.
  - BKZ of 88 €/kW is the Westnetz high-voltage rate from 01.05.2026. I only saw it in search results because the PDF returned 403, so it is not in `quellen` and is labelled as an example value.
  - The Swiss information comes from a consultancy blog (energonia.ch). The fedlex primary text could not be retrieved.
- **Image:** `/img/speicher.jpg` shows a home storage system (fenecon), not a large-scale battery. The alt text describes it honestly. A proper large-storage image would be better.

### 3. `ppa-fuer-unternehmen` – "PPA für Unternehmen: Grünstrom direkt vom Solarpark beziehen"
- **File:** `C:\Users\SALEADMIN\Downloads\Oekoinvest-Web\src\content\ratgeber\ppa-fuer-unternehmen.js`
- **Length:** about 1,835 words, 9 min. reading time. 4 tables, 6 FAQs.
- **Content:**
  - Models: on-site, sleeved or virtual; pay-as-produced, baseload or profile.
  - Prices: dena indicative 35–45 €/MWh for a 10-year solar PPA, and why `ERLOESE.ppaCt` is set higher.
  - A table of `STROM.bestandteile`.
  - Worked example: 3 GWh consumption, average of `ppaDeckungsanteil`, gross advantage plus break-even surcharge, with a strong caveat.
  - Risks (profile, volume, price, credit) and balancing group / imbalance energy.
- **Legal status:**
  - Guarantees of origin: only for unsubsidised plants, register run by the UBA.
  - Electricity tax for manufacturing: 0.05 ct from 01.01.2026, permanent, minimum consumption 12.5 MWh, on application under § 9b.
  - On-site exemption under § 9 Abs. 1 Nr. 3 StromStG.
- **Reststrom-Pool:** presented factually, using only the facts from the briefing. `poolHebel` is labelled "vorsichtige Einschätzung, keine Zusage".
- **Sources:**
  - dena PPA-Marktanalyse 2025: https://www.dena.de/fileadmin/dena/Publikationen/PDFs/2026/PPA_Marktanalyse_2025.pdf
  - pv magazine / Pexapark: https://www.pv-magazine.com/2026/02/18/pexapark-records-12-european-ppas-for-724-mw-in-january/
  - Bundestag, electricity tax: https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2025/kw46-de-energiesteuer-1126268
  - StromStG § 9: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/stromstg/__9.html
  - UBA Herkunftsnachweis: https://www.umweltbundesamt.de/service/uba-fragen/was-ist-ein-herkunftsnachweis
  - BDEW Strompreisanalyse: https://www.bdew.de/service/daten-und-grafiken/bdew-strompreisanalyse/
- **Uncertainties:**
  - The volume threshold for off-site PPAs is only described as "größere Mengen", with no fixed number.
  - AT (E-Control, Elektrizitätsabgabe) and CH (Pronovo) are only mentioned briefly.

### Suggested additions to `markt.js`

**`SPEICHER`**
- `iseaIndex2h: { 2024: 309000, 2025: 259000 }` and `iseaIndex1h: { 2024: 183000, 2025: 151000 }` (€/MW per year). Source: RWTH ISEA / battery-charts.de, via pv magazine 23.01.2026.
- `bkzBeispielProKw: 88`. Source: Westnetz price sheet from 01.05.2026, high voltage.
- `netzanfragen2025Gw: 573.5` and `netzzusagen2025Gw: 54.2`. Source: BNetzA via pv magazine 25.08.2026.
- `bestandGw: 2.4` and `bestandGwh: 3.2`. Source: BNetzA, as of 15.10.2025.
- `opexAnteilCapex: 0.02`, `erloesRueckgang: 0.03`, `laufzeit: 15`. These are assumptions and would need a real source first.

**`ERLOESE`**
- `ppaSolarDena: { min: 35, max: 45 }` €/MWh (producer level, 10 years, as produced) and `ppaWindOnshoreDena: { min: 55, max: 65 }`. Source: dena / Marktoffensive EE, PPA-Marktanalyse 2025.
- Check: `ppaCt` (4.2–6.0 ct) is clearly above the dena values. I explained this in the article as a buyer-side surcharge, but the range should be reviewed.

**`STROM`**
- `stromsteuerMindestverbrauchMwh: 12.5`. Source: Bundestag, 13.11.2025.
